headlines.title: Singer-songwriter and Broadway composer Duncan Sheik dies at 56
headlines.description: Singer-songwriter and Broadway composer Duncan Sheik has died, according to a post on his Instagram account.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy’s Husband and Holdout Juror Break Their Silence
headlines.description: Lindsay Clancy’s former husband, and his new wife, are speaking out for the first time since the mistrial and addressing the emotional case and opening up about their grief. It comes as the lone holdout in the case is offering his version of events inside the jury room and the reasons, he says, he fought for a guilty verdict. NBC's Emilie Ikeda reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Warren Buffett steps down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway
headlines.description: Warren Buffett announced he is stepping down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway after 60 years at the firm. Investopedia editor-in-chief Caleb Silver breaks down how Buffett has impacted the investment world.

headlines.title: Charles 'Sounded Giddily Elated' Over Diana's Death: Earl Spencer
headlines.description: Explosive excerpts from Earl Spencer’s upcoming memoir portray then-Prince Charles behind the scenes as cold hearted about the day Princess Diana died, with Spencer writing Charles “sounded giddily elated, like a lottery winner.” Buckingham Palace has issued a rare and strongly worded denial. NBC’s Daniele Hamamdjian report for TODAY.

headlines.title: Texas college quarterback apologizes for comments about violent AI video
headlines.description: Texas Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning apologized for referencing an AI video showing his coach slapping ESPN sideline reporter Holly Rowe. “In my press conference yesterday, I made an insensitive comment about an AI video. There is nothing funny about it,” Manning wrote.

headlines.title: Hackers breached OpenAI, adding to fever pitch of security and safety concerns
headlines.description: A small group of cybersecurity researchers said Sunday that they broke into OpenAI earlier this year, an announcement that has added a new element of alarm around AI security and safety.

headlines.title: Kim Kardashian’s new health scare: What is Esophagitis?
headlines.description: Kim Kardashian revealed she’s facing a new health condition in the trailer for season eight of “The Kardashians.”

headlines.title: U.S. clears potential $24.3B F-35 sale to Saudi Arabia despite security concerns
headlines.description: The State Department just approved a potential $24.3 billion sale of advanced F-35 fighter jets to Saudi Arabia. But some lawmakers are sounding the alarm that the deal could put America’s top military secrets within reach of China.

headlines.title: Gas prices approach highest level this year with just weeks to go before midterms
headlines.description: U.S. gas prices approached their highest level of the year Friday, after the national average rose another 3 cents overnight.

headlines.title: White House TikTok post goes silent after scathing Zara Larsson critique
headlines.description: A White House TikTok video, celebrating ICE-led deportations went silent on Friday after singer Zara Larsson tore into the administration for using her song “Midnight Sun” in the post.
